main_text.p: viros,qui ius interpretari populo, & respondere solitis sint: sed eos magna profes-sos, in paruis esse versatos. Quid enim est tantum, quantum ius civitatis? Quid autē tam exiguum, quàm est munus hoc, eorum qui consulū-tur? quod tamen est populo necessarium. Nec verò eos qui ei muneri praefuerunt, uni-versi Iuris expertes fuisse existimo. Sed hoc, civile quod vocant, eatenus exercuerunt, quoad populo praestare voluerunt. Id autem incognitū est, minusqueinusu necessa-rium. Quamobrem quò me vocas? aut quid hortaris, ut li-bel-

page.notes: The "»" marks at the start of each printed line are typographic line marks, not text, and are omitted. The running head is partly illegible. The line "minusqueinufunecefsa-" is set with no visible word spaces; it is copied as printed, with spaces only where the words are clearly separate, and should be checked. Long s is written as s. "xiftimo" is transcribed as "existimo" with the printed hyphen restored from "e-". The text ends with the printed hyphen "bel-" and continues on the next page.
